texts.zh:
在对[From.GetName]地下的洞穴进行调查后发现有一种银色液态金属顺着闪光的河水在各个洞穴中穿梭，最后汇入地下湖泊之中。更令人惊讶的是，这个液态金属与有机生命体有很多共同的特性，比如会对环境刺激产生反应、可以进行自我维持。

现在还不能断定这种奇异的金属是否具有生命，但应该能将其用于我们的工程技术之中。
texts.en:
Investigation of the caverns below the surface of [From.GetName] reveal them to be filled with a silvery liquid metal that flows from cavern to cavern in gleaming rivers, pooling into underground lakes. More surprising still is the discovery that this metal substance shares many key properties with organic lifeforms, including responding to environmental stimulus and exhibiting self-sustaining processes.

It remains to be seen whether this exceptional metal should be classified as truly alive - but it may have several practical applications for our engineering technology.

summary.text:
# 深层洞窟 / Deep Caverns

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar）

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。无战略资源的不宜居常规星球可能生成，但权重只有0.1（7级），且 AI 与玩家都可获得（为让 AI 也能找到活体金属）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on an uninhabitable regular planet without strategic resources, but with weight only 0.1 (level 7); AI and players can both get it (so the AI can find living metal too).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.150“活体金属湖”：地下洞窟中流淌着具有类生命特性的银色液态金属。星球获得活体金属矿藏，帝国获得（或推进25%）开采活体金属的科技。30天后的通用接触报告 story.1 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

distar.150 "Living Metal Lakes": the caverns hold silvery liquid metal with life-like properties. The planet gains a living metal deposit and the empire gains the living-metal mining tech option (or 25% progress). The generic contact report story.1 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异的选项。
